paragraphs.text: Chapter 3 A Great Soldier Many years ago, another man grew up in
the valley.
This man left home and joined the army.
He became a great soldier.
After many years of life in the army, he became a general.
He was called old blood and thunder.
He was now very old.
He had many scars from war.
He was tired of military life and decided to return to his home in the valley.
One day, Ernest and his neighbor were talking.
Did you hear the latest rumor Ernest?
Ask the neighbor.
Yes, people say the old general resembles the stone face.
Said Ernest, is it true?
Well, I don't know.
But an assistant to the general came here and said the general looks just like the great stone face.
Replied the neighbor.
We will have to wait until he arrives, said Ernest.
The local townspeople decided to have a large festival to welcome old blood and thunder home.
When this day came, everyone went to town to join the festival.
Ernest went to see the banquet.
It was a really beautiful banquet.
On the table, a feast was prepared.
It looked so delicious.
In the distance, people could see the image of the great stone face.
Ernest could see many people gathering around the banquet.
Ernest stood on his tiptoes to see old blood and thunder.
But there were too many people.
He gave up trying to see.
Instead, he turned to look at the great stone face.
He felt comforted by the smile of the great stone face.
Ernest stood at the back of the crowd for a while.
As he looked at the great stone face, he heard many people around him.
One person said, he looks exactly like the great stone face.
Ernest also heard another say, old blood and thunder is the greatest man.
He is the great stone face.
These people gave a great shout.
Hoorah!
This encouraged other people to do the same.
After listening to everyone, Ernest thought,
this must be the human form of the great stone face.
It must be true.
However, Ernest had not expected the great stone face would be a man of war.
He had expected a man of peace.
He had expected a man of wisdom and knowledge.
But he thought, a man of war can still do great things.
Soon after, he heard someone cry out, the general, it's the general.
He is going to make a speech.
Everyone, please be quiet.
The crowd became quiet.
Finally, the general stood and everyone could see him.
Old blood and thunder began to speak.
But Ernest was not listening to him.
He was looking at the general's face and then his military uniform.
It was very splendid.
It was dark green and had many badges on it.
Ernest watched him for a while and then thought, does he really resemble the great stone face?
Behind the general, Ernest could see the image of the great stone face.
He looked at the face he loved and thought, this face has so much wisdom.
This face has so much kindness and generosity.
Old blood and thunder's face has none of these.
He is not the legendary man.
We all must wait longer.
Ernest left the banquet and went home.
Late that afternoon, he went to sit and watch the great face.
The sunshine shone through the clouds, casting shadows across the face.
The effect of the shadows created a smile on the great face.
It gave a lot of comfort to Ernest.
In his mind, Ernest could hear the face saying, do not worry Ernest, he will come.
Many more years passed by, Ernest grew older and older and now he was a man of middle age.
He was still the same simple-hearted man and everyone knew and loved him.
But he was even wiser now.
He always tried to do his best for others.
Not only did his goodness show in his actions, but also in his speech.
He always talked to others very kindly.
He gave honest advice to people with problems.
He spoke truthfully like no other person could.
Everyone loved Ernest, but no one really knew that Ernest was an extraordinary man.
